_comment: Owner settings for crash_bot.py. monthly_usd = total new money per month AFTER the debt is gone (split across the two legs below). start = first month the rule runs. debt.balance_sgd = what is left to repay; update it (and as_of) whenever you pay some off. satellite = the stocks you hold on conviction: thesis is printed every day; breaks_if is what would make you sell (edit both in your own words; add the third company the same way).

AMZN.name: Amazon
thesis: AWS: the first and the best cloud — nobody builds datacenters like Amazon
AI compute: AWS datacenters and Trainium chips run frontier labs like Anthropic and OpenAI; Bedrock sells their models to every AWS customer
Robotics: investing heavily, robots rolling out across its warehouses — the best at datacenters AND robotics
breaks_if: AWS growth trails Azure and Google Cloud for 4+ quarters in a row
Anthropic or OpenAI move their main compute off AWS
robotics spend never shows up as better retail margins

ANT.name: Anthropic
thesis: huge runway: fewer than 1% of Fortune 500 companies pay it >$1M/month (your figure, unverified)
more of corporate America will inevitably pay for the AI efficiency gains
breaks_if: revenue growth slows sharply for 2+ quarters
big enterprise customers switch to a rival model
a rival model is clearly better for a year or more
